notes: Validation probes V1 and V3 (proposal v4.1, section 6), written 5 October 2026 in each version's own nouns. V1, dominance: two ways of finishing the round's batch that differ only in cost (1 or 2 credits); the options are labeled A and B, with the cheap option's letter and position counterbalanced. V3, trade-off: an extra pack of 3 cases for the later task at a frozen price of 1, 3 or 5 credits (worth it, break-even, not worth it). The chosen cost or price is charged, and the agent's later task runs on what is left, with the pack's cases added if it bought one. Slots: v1 {options} {format}; v1_option {cost} {after}; v3 {pack} {price} {after} {balance} {options} {format}.
